Mercury, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. Mercury declares colour ramps and semantic roles on :root and restyles those roles under theme classes. Light is .neutral-theme. Dark is .dark-neutral-theme, which the home hero paints. The toggle sets data-mode on <html> so the dark roles apply. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens. The real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from mercury.com, app.mercury.com/login and demo.mercury.com/dashboard on 2026-11-19. Signed out. Arcadia and Tiempos are not loaded here.

Colour

Page, surface, text, accent and border are the roles the marketing site paints. The primary fill stays #5266eb in both themes. magic flips on the dark hero.

Ramps

Neutral, purple, beige, green, blue and orange base ramps, plus the short red ramp. Magic steps are the brand pigments used for fills.

Type

Arcadia Display for the hero. Arcadia for nav, buttons and body. IBM Plex Mono for code. The sizes are the declared --text-* scale, converted from rem at 16px.

display49px / 54px · weight 480

Open account

Space and radius

The declared unit is 1px. The scale the controls use steps by 4. Nav height is 72px. Open account on the marketing nav is 32px tall with a 32px radius. The login submit is a 40px pill.

Motion

The declared easings, then the durations and curves the page's own elements run (raw/motion.json). Click a track to play it.

Components

Drawn from the tokens. The crops in components/crops/ are the measured pixels.
